name: Flind
traits: Medium Humanoid (Gnoll) with base land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and +2 natural armor.
Ability adjustments are +6 Strength, +2 Dexterity and +4 Constitution.

Two humanoid Hit Dice give 2d8 HP progression, BAB +1, base saves Fort +3, Ref +0, Will +0, and one racial-HD feat. Racial skill points total 5 × (2 + Int modifier, minimum 1). Listen and Spot are racial class skills.
A flind gains +2 on Charisma-based checks to influence gnolls. A flind can learn to use a flindbar as a martial weapon.

A flindbar deals 2d4 bludgeoning in one hand for a Medium wielder, with a 19–20/×2 critical. It adds +2 to disarm rolls. A proficient wielder can attempt a free disarm upon threatening a critical and before confirming it. That attempt does not provoke.
Starts with Common and Gnoll. Bonus languages are Draconic, Elven, Goblin and Orc. Favored class Ranger. Level adjustment +2.

name: Forestkith Goblin
traits: Small Humanoid (Goblinoid) with land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and +1 natural armor. Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity and −2 Intelligence.

Adds +2 racial to Jump and +8 racial to Climb. Can take 10 on Climb under pressure. In forested terrain gains +4 racial to Hide and Move Silently. Gains +4 racial to Craft (weaving) for nets and treats nets as martial weapons.

Bright sunlight or daylight magic dazzles the goblin. Tree Shape works as the druid spell at caster level 12 and lets it resemble a small tree, shrub or limb. The form ends at sunset or upon taking damage. The goblin cannot dismiss it early.

Discordant Frenzy requires at least three attacking forestkith goblins. Within 30 ft. of that melee, creatures with at most 2 HD become shaken for 1d4 rounds unless they pass a Will save based on Charisma. A successful save protects against the same effect for 24 hours.
Starts with Goblin. Bonus languages are Common, Elven, Giant and Orc. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +1. The class Hit Die replaces the one Hit Die of the printed warrior.

name: Poison Dusk Lizardfolk
traits: Small Humanoid (Reptilian) with land speed 30 ft., low-light vision, and +3 natural armor. Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution and −2 Charisma.
Adds +4 racial to Balance, Jump and Swim. Can apply poison to a weapon without risking accidental exposure. Treats bolas and nets as martial weapons through weapon familiarity.
Chameleon skin adds +5 racial to Hide while visible scales remain free of armor or other covering clothes. Hold Breath permits 4 × Constitution score in rounds before drowning risk.
Two claws and one bite each deal 1d3 base damage. Use the natural attack rules to determine primary and secondary attacks.
Starts with Common and Draconic. Bonus languages are Halfling and Sylvan. Favored class Ranger. Level adjustment +1. The example starts with a class Hit Die and has no added racial Hit Dice.

name: Viletooth Lizardfolk
traits: Medium Humanoid (Reptilian, Dragonblood). Land speed 30 ft. and +5 natural armor carry over from the core lizardfolk. The +2 Constitution adjustment replaces the core ability adjustments.
Dragonblood makes the humanoid eligible for items and abilities keyed to dragons or that subtype, as applicable, and subject to effects that target dragons. Its creature type remains Humanoid.

Two humanoid Hit Dice yield 2d8 HP progression, BAB +1, base saves Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +0, and one racial-HD feat. Racial skills get 5 × (2 + Int modifier, minimum 1) points. Balance, Jump, Swim and Move Silently are racial class skills. The first three gain +4 racial each.
Proficient with simple weapons and shields. Retains two 1d4 claws and a 1d4 bite. A bite also deals 1d6 acid damage as a supernatural effect.
Breathes underwater without a duration limit, replacing the base lizardfolk breath-holding trait. Swim uses ordinary movement rules and racial skill bonus.
Starts with Common and Draconic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Goblin, Gnoll and Orc. Favored class Druid. Level adjustment +1.

name: Sunscorch Hobgoblin
traits: Medium Humanoid (Goblinoid, Dragonblood). Ability adjustments are +2 Constitution and +2 Wisdom in place of the core hobgoblin adjustments.
Dragonblood makes the humanoid eligible for items and abilities keyed to dragons or that subtype, as applicable, and subject to effects that target dragons. Its creature type remains Humanoid.
Keeps a land speed of 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and +4 racial bonus on Move Silently checks from the core hobgoblin.
Adds +2 racial to Bluff and +2 racial to Fortitude saves against nonlethal heat damage. Use the latter for environmental heat instead of general Fortitude or fire resistance.

Starts with Common and Goblin. Bonus languages are Draconic, Dwarven, Infernal, Giant and Orc. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +1. The first class level takes the place of the one Hit Die in the core warrior stat block.
